actions.mechanism: Track each file independently; receiving a stable receipt makes acceptance sticky despite subsequent connection errors.
actions.implementation: Show uploading, accepted, failed, or unconfirmed rows. Exclude accepted rows from retry. Reconcile unconfirmed uploads through receipt status before offering another upload.
actions.check: Interrupt a five-file batch after two receipts arrive. Retrying must send neither accepted file and must clearly identify unresolved rows.
actions.risk: Without receipt reconciliation, a lost response remains unconfirmed.

actions.action: Restore receipts, not local file selections
actions.mechanism: Persist accepted-file references while explicitly distinguishing recoverable server attachments from unavailable browser selections.
actions.implementation: Keep only opaque receipts in local storage for 24 hours. On reopening, resolve their availability; explain that unaccepted files require reselection. Enforce expiry without storing file content.
actions.check: Close during partial success and reopen. Available accepted attachments return without uploading; missing selections and expired or unavailable receipts receive explicit explanations.
actions.risk: Receipt expiry enforcement needs reliable age information; shared-browser exposure requires consideration.

actions.action: Make the reviewed list the submission boundary
actions.mechanism: Separate attachment recovery from case creation; submit only an explicitly approved snapshot containing at most five accepted receipts.
actions.implementation: Provide remove and replace controls. Require unresolved rows to be resolved or explicitly omitted. Invalidate review after changes; disable repeated submission while pending.
actions.check: A sixth attachment, unresolved row, or post-review edit must block submission. Double-clicking Submit must issue one case-creation request.
actions.risk: Client gating alone cannot prevent duplicates after an ambiguous submission response.
